title: Bleach Takes Over Japan With Special Promo Ahead of Anime Finale – Watch
content:
Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is nearing closer than ever to the release of the anime’s final episodes ever, and it has taken over Japan with a cool new promo to get fans ready for the grand finale. Bleach made its return earlier this Summer with the final wave of episodes to bring its anime to an ultimate end. But unfortunately for fans, it was announced that there would be a month long hiatus before the series would air its final two episodes ever. Thankfully, that extra wait will also be over soon.

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity will be releasing the first of its final two episodes in a little under a week from the time of this writing , and it’s going all out for the occasion with a special promo that has been showcased taking over Shibuya screens. The official YouTube channel for the anime has dropped a special look at this promo that really helps to emphasize just how big of a deal this grand finale really is. You can check it out in action below.

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Hypes Final Two Episodes Release

Viz Media has confirmed that Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 49 will be making its debut with Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ on October 19th at 8:30AMPT, and then it will be followed by Episode 50 releasing on October 26th at 8:30AM PT. If you are more interested in the English dub release, however , release dates for those have been confirmed as well with the dubbed Episode 49 debuting on November 23rd at 8:30AM PT followed by Episode 50 on November 30th at 8:30AM PT.

These final two episodes come a month after the final season aired earlier this Summer, and will be adapting the final two chapters from Tite Kubo’s original Bleach manga. These final chapters will hopefully be expanding on that material as well as while the initial version of the fight against Yhwach had been cut short, the anime is already extending it further as Yhwach has invaded all three worlds . That’s something he never pulled off in the manga, so it makes for a much bigger grand finale potentially coming our way this Fall.

How Is Bleach ‘s Anime Going to End?

One major development that fans can look forward to in the final Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity episodes is the debut of Ichigo and Rukia’s future children. The anime has confirmed that Kazui Kurosaki will be voiced by Azusa Tachibana, and Ichika Abarai will be voiced by Ayaka Ohashi for their eventual anime debut. They make their appearance in the final two chapters that take place years after the fight with Yhwach, so fans will hopefully get a fleshed out epilogue with the debut of these final two episodes later this month.

The production staff behind Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity had initially announced the delay for the final two episodes because they needed more time to work on the grand finale, and that makes a lot of sense considering how much has been brought to life thus far . But now after waiting for such a long time to see these final episodes in action, what are you hoping to see in Bleach’ s grand finale? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Black Clover Creator Returns With New Look at Asta’s Wizard King Makeover
content:
Black Clover ‘s creator has returned with a new look at Asta’s Wizard King makeover following the manga’s original finale, and it’s to get ready for a cool new art book release coming to Japan soon. Black Clover ended its 11 years of serialization earlier this year , and with it gave fans the ending that they had hoped to see for Asta since the very beginning of the series. But while the anime is keeping the franchise going with its own return, the original creator behind it all has been keeping the manga alive too.

Black Clover series creator Yuki Tabata has been pretty active since the end of the original series with all sorts of new art and special tributes , and this has given fans cool new looks behind the scenes of how it all came together. But with a new digital art book coming to Japan later this November, the cover art for the release has shared the best look yet at Asta’s official Wizard King outfit that fans get to see at the end of the original series. Check it out in action below.

Black Clover Shows Off Wizard King Asta With New Art Book Cover

Although Black Clover has dropped a special art book shortly after the end of the original series’ run, there’s a cool new digital art book release coming to Japan. Scheduled for a release in the region on November 10th, this new Black Clover digital art book includes some of the Shonen Jump covers and various standout pages during the manga’s original magazine run. But this new art book will also be including some brand new illustrations from Yuki Tabata himself, and that is seen with the new cover art for the book showing off Asta’s grand finale makeover.

Black Clover began with Asta declaring his dream of becoming the Clover Kingdom’s Wizard King, and the finale of the series actually brought this to fruition. With the way that Naruto ended and seemingly kept him away from his dream of becoming the Hokage, longtime Shonen Jump fans had been concerned that it would be the same case here. But luckily for Asta, he was able to ascend to this role thanks to how much strength he had built up through all of his fights in the series overall. It was a title he earned with the respect of the rest of the kingdom.

What’s Next for Black Clover ?

Black Clover might have ended its original manga run earlier this year, but the franchise has returned stronger than ever with a new season of the anime airing its episodes this Fall . Black Clover Season 2 picks up after the events of the first season released five years ago, and throws fans right back into the fights against the Spade Kingdom’s Dark Triad. This is the penultimate arc of the original manga series, so it won’t be too much longer until the anime reaches its own grand finale.

Black Clover Season 2 has yet to reveal how many episodes it’s going to be running for as of this time, but it’s likely not going to be anywhere near the massive 170 episode debut season. With only two more arcs to adapt (and much of those arcs being extended fight sequences), there is going to be a lot packed into these final episodes. Are you excited for Black Clover’ s big comeback this Fall? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Naruto Card Game Shows Off Dream Fights in Special Anime Trailer – Watch
content:
Naruto is gearing up to make its official card game debut next year, and it is showing off some of the dream match ups that fans will be able to make happen with a special new trailer from the original studio behind the Naruto anime. The Naruto franchise has quite a lot in the works as it gears up for a wave of big new plans for the future. There are not only new anime and manga projects now in the works , but there’s even a real life trading card game on the way too.

Naruto took the stage during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend to reveal the first looks at what to expect from the franchise over the years to come , and it includes the release of NARUTO CARD GAME next Summer. Currently scheduled for a release in June 2027, the trading card game showed off the first look at some of the first releases that fans will get to see when it hits. But kicking open the door in a strong way is a special animated trailer for NARUTO CARD GAME that is brought to life by Pierrot, the same studio behind the Naruto TV anime series. Check it out in action below.

Naruto Card Game Releases Special Anime Trailer

NARUTO CARD GAME will be making its simultaneous launch worldwide in June 2027, but has yet to confirm a concrete release date as of this time. The launch line up for the new game will have three Starter Decks led by Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha and Gaara. The game’s first booster pack (dubbed “Enter: Naruto Uzumaki!”) will be launching at the same time as well. There will be in-store preview events demoing the upcoming game beginning next February, with a bigger global campaign distributing one million Demo Decks in Spring 2027.

The starter decks are centering around the three major characters with character support cards and more that fans will then be able to shake up with additional booster pack releases. We’ve seen a lot of trading card games absolutely blow up over the last few years (a single look at One Piece will tell you how big of a deal they are now ), so there’s absolutely a chance that the same will happen here considering that Naruto is one of the biggest anime franchises that’s on the cusp of a much bigger return soon.

What’s Next for Naruto ?

Naruto has also unveiled some huge plans through at least 2029 as part of Project Rasengan. It’s a new initiative that not only includes this new trading card game, but a new video game release and more of the anime and manga. NARUTO x NINKU is an official crossover anime that has been announced that will unite these two classic Shonen Jump franchises with a revival four episode special uniting their respective ninja heroes into a new adventure showing off all of their skills.

There’s something even bigger on the way, however, as Naruto creator Masashi Kishimoto is returning to the franchise for a new phase of the story. Naruto Shadow Rising has been officially announced as a brand new manga set after the events of the original series, and seemingly before the events of the Boruto: Naruto Next Generations sequel series. It’s yet to be revealed when this new manga will hit, but more will be revealed at Jump Festa 2027 later this year.

Will you be diving into the new Naruto trading card game when it hits next year? Are you excited for more of Naruto ‘s anime future? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: 'The Fable 2nd Season' Announces Additional Cast
content:
The official website for the The Fable television anime revealed additional cast and the main visual (pictured) for its second season on Wednesday. The new season will adapt the Yamaoka-hen ( Yamaoka Arc ) from Katsuhisa Minami 's crime comedy manga and is scheduled to premiere on the Nippon TV network on January 10, 2027, airing every Sunday at 12:55 a.m.

Cast Yamaoka: Kouichi Yamadera ( Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen ) Azami: Takanori Hoshino ( Sentai Red Isekai de Boukensha ni Naru ) Eucalyptus: Hiroyuki Yoshino ( Yomi no Tsugai ) Koji Mizuno: Satoshi Mikami ( Kami no Shizuku ) Jiro: Taiten Kusunoki ( Hidarikiki no Eren ) Suzumushi: Seiyuu Fujiwara ( Liar Game )

Ryousuke Takahashi ( Soukou Kihei Votoms ) is returning to direct the second season at Tezuka Productions . Yuuya Takashima is handling the series composition. Mayumi Morita ( Megami no Café Terrace ) and Yuuya Takashima are writing the script. Saki Hasegawa ( Darwin Jihen sub-character design) and Kyuuma Ooshita ( My Home Hero chief animation director) are designing the characters. Yo Tsuji ( Tasokare Hotel ) is composing the music.

The first season aired in 25 episodes in Spring 2024. Disney+ and Hulu simulcasted the anime with subtitles and dub in multiple languages.

Minami serialized the manga in Weekly Young Magazine from November 2014 to November 2019. The sequel, The Fable: The Second Contact , serialized in the same magazine from July 2021 to July 2023.

A second sequel, The Fable: The Third Secret , began in March 2025. Kodansha shipped The Third Secret 's fifth volume on July 6, with the sixth volume scheduled to go on sale on November 6.

Kodansha USA licensed the original manga in English in March 2022 and released the 22nd and final volume in January 2024. All three manga series are simulpublished on the K Manga platform.

The Fable won at the 41st Kodansha Manga Awards in the General category in 2017. The manga is also placed among the top 20 titles in the Kono Manga ga Sugoi! rankings' Male Readers division in 2019 and 2020 .

title: The Fable Season 2 TV Anime Reveals More Cast, January 9 Premiere
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Katsuhisa Minami 's The Fable manga announced on Wednesday six cast members and the January 9 premiere for the anime's second season . The website also unveiled a visual:

The newly announced cast includes (pictured above from left to right):

• Takanori Hoshino as Azami

• Kōichi Yamadera as Yamaoka

• Hiroyuki Yoshino as Yukari

• Taiten Kusunoki as Jiro

• Satoshi Mikami as Koji Mizuno

• Seiyū Fujiwara as Suzumushi

The anime will premiere on NTV on January 9 at 12:55 a.m. JST (effectively, January 10).

• Kazuyuki Okitsu as Akira Satō

• Miyuki Sawashiro as Yōko Satō

• Kana Hanazawa as Misaki Shimizu

• Akio Ohtsuka as Takeshi Ebihara

• Tetsuo Komura as Boss

• Jun Fukushima as Jackal Tomioka

• Kouji Ishii as Hiroshi Hamada (Oyaji)

• Ryōta Iwasaki as Kuroshio (Kuro)

• Yūdai Mino as Katsuya Takahashi

• Koujirou Takahashi as Shūichi Sunagawa

• Kiyomitsu Mizuuchi as Matsu

• Takeharu Ōnishi as Kenjirō Takōda (President Octopus)

• Takumi Asahina as Etsuji Kainuma

• Kazuya Ichijou as Master

• Yūki Kaji as Yūki Kawai (Be Daiyocha)

Ryōsuke Takahashi ( Armored Trooper Votoms , Phoenix , Ozma ) is returning to direct the anime at Tezuka Productions . Sci-fi writer Yūya Takashima is again handling the series composition, and writing the scripts with Mayumi Morita ( Black Jack TV , Vampire Knight ). Returning character designers include Kyūma Ōshita and Saki Hasegawa . Yasuyuki Urakami ( Detective Conan ) is returning as the sound director. Yo Tsuji ( Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions ) is the new music composer.

The anime premiered in April 2024 and aired for two continuous cours (quarters of a year). Disney+ is streaming the series worldwide, and Hulu is streaming the series in the United States. The anime also has an English dub .

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the original manga in English, and it describes the series:

When you're the infamous "genius killer" hitman The Fable, many things come easy. Being a normal person, however, isn't one of them. In fact, being told that he can't kill anyone for a while may just be the hardest job he's ever taken...

Minami launched the original manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine in November 2014, and ended the series in November 2019. The manga has 22 compiled book volumes. The series won Best General Manga at the 41st annual Kodansha awards in 2017.

The original manga inspired two live-action films, which opened in Japan in June 2019 and June 2021, respectively.

Minami launched the The Fable: The Second Contact manga as a sequel to the first manga in July 2021. The sequel manga ended its serialization in July 2023. The manga serves as the "second part" to the overall manga franchise . Kodansha released the manga's ninth and final volume in November 2023. The manga's third part The Fable: The third secret launched in March 2025. Kodansha 's K MANGA service is releasing the manga as a simulpub.

The manga is inspiring the The Fable : Manga Build Roguelike roguelike deckbuilder game from Kodansha Game Creators' Lab and developer Mono Entertainment.

title: Major Crunchyroll Isekai Finally Drops English Dub for Its Big Movie After 7 Years
content:
A major Crunchyroll isekai has finally dropped its English dub release for the anime’s big movie seven long years after its initial release. It’s been a big year for Yojo Senki: Saga of Tanya the Evil. While there have been a number of big Isekai franchises returning for new episodes across the year thus far, there are a few shows that have had fans waiting a long time to see them return . But unfortunately, it’s been a much longer wait for fans of the English dub release for the anime.

Yojo Senki: Saga of Tanya the Evil has had a feature film release that originally hit theaters across Japan in 2019, and has been available for streaming with Crunchyroll for some time. But unfortunately for fans of the English dub, this feature film was only available with Japanese language audio with English subtitles. Thankfully it seems that now that the English dub had returned for the second season , they’ve been able to work on the film as the English dub for -Saga of Tanya the Evil- The Movie is now streaming with Crunchyroll too .

Saga of Tanya the Evil Movie English Dub Now Streaming With Crunchyroll

Yojo Senki: Saga of Tanya the Evil has had fans waiting quite a long time for the TV anime franchise to return. The series made its comeback this Summer nine long years after the end of the first season, but at least there was this feature film release launched sometime after to help ease the wait a bit. But for fans of the dub, they’ve been holding out that near decade all this time without anything to ease the wait. But thankfully this new dub release makes the franchise pretty much complete as the dubbed episodes for the second season will be wrapping up their run soon enough.

Yojo Senki: Saga of Tanya the Evil is one of the more interesting isekai anime releases of the 2010s. title: South Park Brings Back Kyle & Ike With New Season 29 Episode First Look Trailer – Watch Now
content:
South Park Season 29 is back with a new episode this week, and the first look trailer is teasing a new story for Kyle and Ike. South Park Season 29 has made some big adjustments to the way it has been telling its stories compared to last year with a renewed focus on the town and boys themselves . The second episode might have been one of the wildest yet, but it never lost sight of the fact it was Butters’ story at the center. Now there’s a tease that Kyle and Ike will get the same treatment.

South Park Season 29 has dropped the first look teaser for Episode 3 ahead of its release this Wednesday, and with it sees Ike getting involved in “aura battles” as Kyle tries his best to save his brother from being labeled as “cringe.” It’s yet another take on a modern trend with kids , so it’s time to see what South Park has to say about it. You can check out the next episode preview in the teaser trailer below as shared by its official social media.

South Park Season 29 Episode 3 First Look Preview Released

South Park Season 29 Episode 3 will be making its debut with Comedy Central on Wednesday, October 14th at 10PM ET, and the synopsis for the episode teases it as such, “When aura battles take over South America, Kyle tries to help his little brother not be cringe.” This is going to be the first episode focused on Kyle and Ike in quite some time, so it’s definitely a welcome move forward just like the first two episodes have been. Because when it was first revealed that the show would be changing its name to “South America” for the season , it did have fans worried a bit.

“South America” seemed to be set up as a big gimmick for the season, and following two seasons dominated by outside political events and characters, it’s being treated in a much different way than fans expected . It’s something quietly going on in the background through all of the episodes thus far, and instead each of the episodes have focused on the characters that fans have wanted to see. And this next episode bringing Kyle and Ike back into the main focus is a step further in that great direction.

What’s Next for South Park Season 29?

This is the third episode of the currently scheduled six episodes slated for South Park Season 29 thus far. Much like last year, the release schedule revealed confirms that new episodes will be released on a biweekly basis. This season has been held in high regard with just two episodes so far , so there’s a hope that this next episode can keep up that hot streak going in. As for the rest of the season, South Park Season 29 lays out its schedule as such:

• Episode 4 – October 28th

• Episode 5 – November 11th

• Episode 6 – November 25th

South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone had laid out a deal with Paramount ahead of the recent Warner Bros. merger where they agreed to release ten new episodes of the series a year across five years, so there are still four potential episodes left unaccounted for as of this time. We’ll just have to see what’s next for the rest of the year, but what are you hoping to see from Kyle and Ike in the next episode? Let us know all of your thoughts in the comments!

title: Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance Anime Film's Trailer Reveals Theme Song
content:
The official website for Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance (Heart's Resonance), the all-new feature-length anime film sequel to the Expelled from Paradise film, began streaming on Tuesday a trailer, and it reveals and previews the theme song "Beyond the Night" by TeddyLoid feat. Ayane Sakura (as Gabriel) and Nagi Inoue (from Nogizaka46 ).

The song will launch digitally on November 11 and physically on November 18.

While the original announcement of the film had featured the title Rakuen Tsuihō : Liberated from Paradise , a later announcement listed the title as Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance as well as Rakuen Tsuihō: Kokoro no Resonance instead.

The cast members are:

• Ayane Sakura as Gabriel

• Saori Hayami as Alma

• Yoshino Aoyama as Danel

• Sally Amaki as Raguel

• Sumire Morohoshi as Penem

Rie Kugimiya reprises her role as Angela Balzac in the film.

The film reunites the main staff of Expelled from Paradise , including director Seiji Mizushima , scriptwriter Gen Urobuchi of Nitroplus , character designer Masatsugu Saitō , and composer NARASAKI . Toei Animation is producing the animation.

The other staff members include:

• Mechanical Designers: Kanetake Ebikawa, Junya Ishigaki, Takayuki Yanase

• Animation Supervisor: Naoki Ogita

• Modeling Supervisor: Kento Kume

• Mecha Modeling Lead: Toyokazu Hashimoto

• Producer: Kōichi Ioguchn

Expelled from Paradise debuted in 13 theaters in Japan in November 2014, and sold 110,000 tickets. The film's Blu-ray Disc and DVD release in Japan sold more than 70,000 copies. The film won the Best Animation of the Year Award at the 24th Japan Movie Critics Awards in May 2015.

Aniplex of America released Expelled from Paradise in 15 theaters across the United States in December 2014. The company then released the film on Blu-ray Disc in North, Central, and South America in June 2015.

The film returned to theaters in Japan in November 2024 in 4K resolution as Expelled from Paradise -Impelled by 10th Anniversary- to commemorate the film's 10-year anniversary.

title: 'Kusuriya no Hitorigoto' Movie Reveals Additional Cast, Character Trailers
content:
The official website for the Kusuriya no Hitorigoto anime series revealed the additional cast and two character trailers for the anime movie on Tuesday. The movie, subtitled Bouhi no Hihou ( The Secret Treasure of the Deceased Consort ), opens in Japanese theaters on December 11.

Cast Birou: Nobuo Tobita ( Youjo Senki ) Shuu-u: Kumiko Watanabe ( Tomo-chan wa Onnanoko! ) Bisen: Hirofumi Nojima ( Komekami! Girls ) Suija: Kensho Ono ( Jigokuraku ) Eishou: Ryouta Takeuchi ( Nippon Sangoku ) Kaja: Jirou Saitou ( Kami no Niwatsuki Kusunoki-tei )

Norihiro Naganuma ( Mahoutsukai no Yome ) is directing the anime movie at TOHO animation STUDIO . Yuuko Kakihara ( Ao no Hako ) is writting the script. Yukiko Nakatani ( One Piece: Episode of Luffy - Hand Island no Bouken ) is designing the characters and credited as chief animation director. Satoru Kousaki ( Bakemonogatari ), Kevin Penkin ( Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari ), and Alisa Okehazama ( Jujutsu Kaisen ) are composing the music.

Produced by OLM and TOHO animation STUDIO, the first and second season aired in Fall 2023 and Winter 2025, respectively, each airing in 24 episodes. Crunchyroll streamed the anime with subs and dubs in multiple languages, excluding Asia.

Hyuuga began penning the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in October 2011. Shufunotomo began publishing the novel under its Hero Bunko imprint with illustrations by Touko Shino in August 2014 and published the 16th volume in May 2025.

Nekokurage began drawing a manga adaptation in Big Gangan in May 2017. Square Enix published the 17th volume on July 24.

A second manga adaptation by Minoji Kurata began serializing in Sunday Gene-X in August 2017. Shogakukan published the 22nd volume on June 18.

J-Novel Club licensed the light novel for digital release in English in November 2020 and published the 16th volume on May 29. Square Enix licensed the manga adaptation for English release in November 2019 and published the 15th volume on March 17. The 16th volume is scheduled to release on November 3.

title: Talent Agency Intention Announces Dissolution on March 31, 2027
content:
The company added that management operations will continue normally until its dissolution, and that it will give the utmost support for its affiliated talents' future.

Intention announced in June that Suzumura would gradually return to voice acting work after going on hiatus in February earlier this year. Intention explained at the time that Suzumura had been in poor health, and doctors diagnosed the issue as adjustment disorder.

Suzumura went on a previous hiatus due to his health in May 2024, and gradually resumed his work two months later.

Suzumura started the Intention talent agency in 2009. Aside from Suzumura, the company's talents include Yūichi Nakamura , Aya Endō , Nao Tōyama , Kazuhiro Nakaya , Yūma Uchida , Shōya Ishige , Ayaka Asai , Natsumi Kawaida , Shūichi Uchida , Akari Tadano , and Natsuko Abe .
